name: The lab
description: A shed the expedition built out of the lander's plates to work in out of the wind: a riveted front with a patch and rust down its seams, a side going back into the dark, a single slope of corrugated roof. A jar of caps sits on the sill inside, so its window is lit a little. Readings are pinned up by the door, which is a canvas flap tied back; a crate of instruments with a coil of wire and a stool stand outside. A mast on the roof carries the wind meter (`ss.base.vane`), and a cable runs down the side toward the bench. Nothing to do here in feelers; it is the back of the east wing.
